# Eventbrite
> Eventbrite is an event discovery, ticketing, marketing, and event management platform for attendees and organizers.

Eventbrite helps people find local and online events while giving creators tools to publish events, sell tickets, market experiences, manage attendees, and collect payments across many event types.

## Core Platform
- [Eventbrite Home](https://www.eventbrite.com/): Main entry point for discovering events and accessing organizer tools.
- [Find Events](https://www.eventbrite.com/d/local/events/): Browse local events by location, category, and date.
- [Find My Tickets](https://www.eventbrite.com/signin/signup?referrer=%2Fmytickets): Sign in to access purchased tickets and registrations.
- [Sign In](https://www.eventbrite.com/signin/): Account access for attendees and event organizers.
- [Organizer Overview](https://www.eventbrite.com/organizer/overview): Overview of Eventbrite tools for creating, promoting, and managing events.

## Ticketing & Event Management
- [Sell Tickets](https://www.eventbrite.com/l/sell-tickets/): Event ticketing platform for publishing events and selling paid or free tickets.
- [Payments](https://www.eventbrite.com/l/event-payment/): Payment collection tools for processing ticket sales and event revenue.
- [Online Events](https://www.eventbrite.com/l/virtual-events-platform/): Platform features for hosting and managing virtual events.
- [Eventbrite for Business](https://www.eventbrite.com/l/eventbrite-for-business/): Solutions for internal, client-facing, and corporate event programs.

## Marketing & Promotion
- [Event Marketing Platform](https://www.eventbrite.com/l/event-marketing-platform/): Marketing tools for promoting events and growing attendance.
- [Eventbrite Ads](https://www.eventbrite.com/l/eventbrite-ads/): Paid promotion product for increasing event visibility and ticket sales.
- [Organizer Overview](https://www.eventbrite.com/organizer/overview): Includes promotion, audience growth, and event management capabilities.

## Industry Solutions
- [Music](https://www.eventbrite.com/l/music/): Ticketing and promotion tools tailored for music events and live performances.
- [Concerts](https://www.eventbrite.com/l/music-venues/): Solutions for concert promoters, venues, and live music ticket sales.
- [Food & Beverage](https://www.eventbrite.com/l/food-drink-event-ticketing/): Ticketing for tastings, food festivals, and beverage-focused events.
- [Performing Arts](https://www.eventbrite.com/l/performing-arts/): Event tools for theaters, arts organizations, and performance venues.
- [Charity & Causes](https://www.eventbrite.com/l/npo/): Event management and fundraising support for nonprofits and cause-based organizations.
- [Retail](https://www.eventbrite.com/l/host-retail-events/): Event solutions for retail activations, in-store experiences, and brand events.

## Event Formats
- [Classes & Workshops](https://www.eventbrite.com/l/create-a-workshop/): Tools for creating educational sessions, classes, and workshops.
- [Festivals & Fairs](https://www.eventbrite.com/l/festival-solutions/): Ticketing and operations support for festivals, fairs, and large gatherings.
- [Conferences](https://www.eventbrite.com/l/conferences/): Features for conference registration, promotion, and attendee management.
- [Corporate Events](https://www.eventbrite.com/l/eventbrite-for-business/): Business-focused event workflows for teams and organizations.
- [Online Events](https://www.eventbrite.com/l/virtual-events-platform/): Virtual event setup, registration, and attendee access tools.

## Discovery & Attendance
- [Local Events](https://www.eventbrite.com/d/local/events/): Search and browse nearby events happening in local markets.
- [Eventbrite Home](https://www.eventbrite.com/): Explore featured events, categories, and popular experiences.
- [Find My Tickets](https://www.eventbrite.com/signin/signup?referrer=%2Fmytickets): Retrieve registrations and tickets for upcoming events.

## Organizer Resources
- [Organizer Overview](https://www.eventbrite.com/organizer/overview): Starting point for organizers evaluating Eventbrite’s platform capabilities.
- [Sell Tickets](https://www.eventbrite.com/l/sell-tickets/): Core organizer workflow for launching and monetizing events.
- [Event Marketing Platform](https://www.eventbrite.com/l/event-marketing-platform/): Promotion features for audience acquisition and event growth.
- [Payments](https://www.eventbrite.com/l/event-payment/): Revenue collection and payout information for organizers.
- [Eventbrite Ads](https://www.eventbrite.com/l/eventbrite-ads/): Advertising option for boosting event reach on the platform.

## Business Use Cases
- [Eventbrite for Business](https://www.eventbrite.com/l/eventbrite-for-business/): Event management for companies running recurring or large-scale programs.
- [Conferences](https://www.eventbrite.com/l/conferences/): Registration and promotion workflows for professional conferences.
- [Retail](https://www.eventbrite.com/l/host-retail-events/): Customer engagement events for stores and retail brands.
- [Charity & Causes](https://www.eventbrite.com/l/npo/): Nonprofit event workflows for fundraising and community engagement.
- [Festivals & Fairs](https://www.eventbrite.com/l/festival-solutions/): Large-event ticketing and attendee operations for public events.
